note: 巡回动物园的宠物商人；来找玩家买饲料；热情口语；把宠物爱称为小家伙、小馋鬼；带笑意，不贬低宠物。

messages.raw: §fHey, you got some wheat for my pets by any chance? Gotta keep those little monsters fed, haha!
messages.text: Hey, you got some wheat for my pets by any chance? Gotta keep those little monsters fed, haha!
messages.zh: 嘿,你这儿有没有小麦,给我的宠物们吃点? 这群小馋鬼可饿不得,哈哈!

messages.raw: §fYou know how it is, they never stop eating haha, thank you very much!
messages.text: You know how it is, they never stop eating haha, thank you very much!
messages.zh: 你也知道,这些小家伙的嘴就没停过,哈哈。真是太谢谢你了!
